findings.desc: M2 runner readiness does not bind deterministic seed lineage or mechanically compare the M2 phase1 runner manifest to the frozen M1 seed/cell contract. CHK-002 requires required Phase 1 cells ③/⑥/② with deterministic seed linkage, but phase1-runner-manifest.m2.json only records counts/cell families and task ids, while the M1 seed policy derives seeds from protocolDigest|cellNumber|taskSlot|scenarioSlot|repeatSlot. The M2 checker validates counts and required cell presence, but it does not read seed-manifest.m1.json or cell-matrix.m1.json, does not bind taskId/ordinal back to M1 taskSlot ids, and does not assert each M2 cell mirrors the frozen M1 arm/executor/reviewer/row semantics. A future provider-execution story could therefore consume a passing M2 readiness layer with ambiguous or drifted seed/cell linkage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 2c7bc625e914f5e0c404cbfe729e0cd60f5b49ea. M2 now binds seed-manifest.m1.json and cell-matrix.m1.json, maps each concrete task to task-slot-01..24, and m2-launch-readiness-check mechanically validates M1 protocolDigest, seed derivation policy, dimensions, cell semantics, A2prime gate, planned counts, and task-slot mapping. Verified with node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m2-launch-readiness-check.mjs (1105 assertions, 21 negative controls), node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m1-freeze-check.mjs, and lattice scope_contract_check --storyId=B-fe25.
